needsPatrick.item: Create a Semaphore account and share an API key
needsPatrick.recommendation: Prepaid credits only; no real sends until the pilot clinic approves

needsPatrick.item: Book 3 dental or vet clinic meetings for the prototype demo
needsPatrick.recommendation: Target the week after the prototype ships

needsPatrick.item: Register the business (DTI) and send one email to DTI Pampanga on free events and announcements
Legal check: dental testimonials, texting a family number about a dependent (DPA s.13), and keeping an opt-out after an erasure request
needsPatrick.recommendation: One consult covers all three. Until then: testimonials off for dental, texts about dependents name nothing (not even cleaning or check-up), and erased opt-outs are kept
Revisit is a placeholder. Pick a global, non-Filipino brand before the first clinic demo; Claude can shortlist names with free .com domains

needsPatrick.item: Scope of the cleaning / check-up / consultation allowlist: aesthetic and other clinics, and Filipino words (linis, konsulta)
needsPatrick.recommendation: Yes to all human clinics (the sender name already says more than the word) and yes to linis and konsulta. Dependents stay strict until the legal consult
